jobs.title: ​​Sr. Manager, Digital Product Manager​
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As a ​​Sr. Manager, Digital Product Manager​ for AI, Data Analytics & Reporting Product Area, you will lead the strategy, development, and adoption of data and digital platforms that enable GCS operations. By advancing analytics capabilities, system integration, and data connectivity across the GCS ecosystem, you will improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and accelerate the delivery of supply to sites.

You will be responsible for working with the product area lead, business stakeholders, and development teams to evaluate key business problems, impacts from feature releases and experimentation results to continuously advance and evolve user experiences.

Working in close partnership with the user community and other stakeholders across the Digital organizations, you will analyze and interpret business needs and translate them into powerful, functional, beautiful, and well-integrated software products that generate novel scientific insights, enhance productivity, and drive a superior user experience.

Through your compelling vision and inspirational leadership, you will lead a matrixed, cross-functional product team consisting of software, data and infrastructure engineers, designers, and user supporters who are responsible for delivering on your product roadmap.

You will demonstrate excellence in product management by combining clinical supply expertise with technology to deliver innovative digital solutions. You will define and manage product roadmaps and backlogs, while measuring value and business impact through meaningful KPIs, ROI assessments, and outcome-driven metrics.

You will deliver consistent, stable product operations, and meet all security, stability, usability, performance, and sustainability requirements. You will energetically evangelize and promote your products, give demos, and prove the impact of your solutions on Pfizer and our patients.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI, Data Analytics & Reporting Product Area.

- Within the Product Model, serve as the primary liaison between GCS and Digital stakeholders and technical teams to translate operational challenges into product opportunities.

- Define and maintain the product release calendar, driving alignment across business and delivery teams through proactive communication and stakeholder engagement.

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of GCS digital products, from ideation and design to delivery and continuous improvement.

- Establish and track KPIs and OKRs to measure product success, user adoption, and business impact.

- Lead product meetings and stakeholder engagements, facilitating discussions, aligning priorities, and driving informed decision-making across cross-functional teams.

- Define, own, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business strategy, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and organizational objectives to maximize product value delivery.

- Promote user-centered design and seamless integration across the clinical supply ecosystem.

- Collaborate with engineering, data, and platform teams to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field) and 7+ years of relevant experience in data, analytics, engineering, digital delivery, or product management.

- 5+ years of hands-on product management or product ownership experience for digital, data, or AI products.

- Strong product management and business analysis skills, with the ability to analyze customer journeys, user behavior, product performance, and digital analytics to drive informed decisions.

- Hands-on experience working in agile teams, processes, and practices .

- Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to understand underlying business problem, perform full cycle analysis and propose recommendations and solutions

- Experience translating business requirements into structured backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and communicating in both directions between business and technical audiences.

- Experience in data science, machine learning and AI

- Ability to conduct independent problem solving and data exploration analysis

- Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills required

- Working fluency with modern AI tools, sufficient to independently build POCs, mockups, or preliminary wireframes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Advanced degree in computer science, data science, logistics or another business-related discipline

- Experience managing delivery through external vendor or contractor teams.

- Agile and Scrum certification

- Demonstrated leadership skills with a proven ability to influence stakeholders, drive change, and deliver results across cross-functional teams

- Experience with generative and agentic AI solutions and platforms .

- Experience with computer systems validation and delivering solutions to GxP requirements

Please apply by sending your CV in English.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Purpose
Breakthroughs that change patients' lives ... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy
One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

Flexibility
We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Equal Employment Opportunity
We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

Disability Inclusion
Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, CFC CRM Product Manager
jobs.location: United States - New York - New York City
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY
The CFC (Customer-Facing Colleagues – the pharmaceutical sales reps out in the field) Product Manager is a new role within the CRM Product team directly reporting to the CRM CFC Business Product Leader within the Chief Marketing Office (CMO).

This is a high-visibility role, owning the end-to-end success of our CRM platform supporting HCP/HCO-facing colleagues (CFC) globally, across all brands representing the needs for Commercial Sales, KAM, Access and Medical user groups.  Over the next several years Pfizer will be re-platforming our CRM technology and this role will be key to shaping a next generation, AI enabled experience.

The role is expected to leverage the product model to identify technology enhancement opportunities that enable Pfizer’s business objectives and improve the CFC experience.  They will collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders to prioritize opportunities and contribute to the strategic CFC product roadmap.  They will partner closely with our digital technology teams and vendors to concept, plan, build and deploy solutions responsible for the end-to-end success.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Contribute to a CFC CRM roadmap illustrating planned technology enhancements to create business impact well aligned to market business objectives.
- Owns outcomes, not just plans — relentlessly focused on what actually moves the needle for users and creates real impact for the business, and willing to course correct when stakeholder signals suggest a different path.
- Forge strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand CFC needs and translate them into technology enhancement opportunities.
- Lead customer/market-facing solution demonstrations adapted for sales/medical/KAM personas that position the platform benefits and drive a demo-led approach to requirements gathering and solution definition.
- Willingness to learn the product/platform capabilities inside-out and do basic configuration to test new features and prepare for demos.
- Lead a process to quantify business impact of enhancement opportunities and drive enhancement prioritization.
- Experienced working in a fast-paced environment that ships fast, iterates, and uses constant experimentation to shape product
- Partner closely with UX/Design, delivery and operations teams to drive concepting, planning, build and deployment of new features.
- Write product requirements and user stories and participate in agile ceremonies to prioritize the backlog and deliver work.
- Devise an approach to measure and report out business impact of technology enhancements.
- Plan and support the functional/business side of the CFC tooling universe by providing clear requirements for business needs throughout, participating in UAT, training and communications as required.
- Manage relationships with vendors to ensure their technologies evolve with Pfizer’s needs. Maintain strong knowledge of Life Sciences CFC CRM-related offerings, drive build/buy decisions and partner closely with digital to evaluate technology.
- Operate with a mindset of standardization, consolidation and global scalability across the CFC technology tooling universe.
- Support privacy, digital, legal, regulatory and compliance teams in setting and deploying data standards, policies and procedures.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree required; Master’s preferred
- 5+ years in a product manager role owning a commercial product sold to external customers or businesses - Experience primarily based on product manager/owner roles managing internal platform product serving internal functions, or services implementer products is not aligned with this role.

- 5+ years in a product manager role at a B2B or B2C technology/SaaS company, with a product culture grounded in owning a product end-to-end from strategy through delivery
- Navigating consumer privacy and / or healthcare data landscape at scale
- Integrating sales and marketing technology and customer journeys across channels
- Deep understanding and passion for sales and marketing challenges
- Ability to forge strong relationships with engineering partners
- Experience evaluating product decisions strategically and making prioritization tradeoffs, leveraging large datasets to make data driven product decisions while collaborating with multiple stakeholders and cross functional teams.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and mastery of working in a matrixed environment.
- Self-motivated with demonstrated ability to execute with speed and high quality.
- Demonstrated business acumen strong analytical skills and mindset.
- Role model for the Pfizer values (Courage, Excellence, Equity, Joy)
- Experience in leading complex, large scale business projects and initiatives, identifying risks and removing roadblocks to enable teams to achieve successful delivery.
- Strong writing, presentation and influencing skills.
- Ability to thrive under pressure, take accountability and to meet deadlines.
- Discretion and trustworthiness in dealing with confidential information.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)
- Master's degree
- Experience working for a product company that sells to Life Sciences or an adjacent industry (e.g. Hospitals/Health Systems, Payers/Insurers, Med Devices, Diagnostics, Consumer Health, Health Tech, EHR Vendors, Health Care Information Technology, Wearables..etc)
- Experience with Veeva, Life Sciences Cloud or OCE
- Experience with Salesforce
- Product experience in a high growth start-up
- Experience working on global programs
- Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.
- Any US Pfizer site preferred for this role with flexibility to work across global time zones

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Up to 50% travel, ability to adapt to meetings scheduled for European/Asian time zones when required

Other Job Details:
- Last day to apply: October 20, 2026

- Work Location Assignment: Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite/week, Commercial Pfizer site required
- Eligible for employee referral bonus

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Drug Product Analytics
jobs.description:
SENIOR MANAGER, DRUG PRODUCT ANALYTICS

POSITION SUMMARY

You will lead a team of Analytical Scientists supporting Pfizer’s small-molecule portfolio from early development through commercialization. You will provide scientific and people leadership for analytical development, control strategy, and project delivery, working closely with Drug Product Development and Supply and other CMC functions.

You will be accountable for defining phase-appropriate analytical strategies, translating scientific data into clear project recommendations, and ensuring robust analytical deliverables aligned with program timelines and regulatory expectations. You will also coach and develop scientists, strengthen technical capabilities, and identify opportunities to improve development speed, scientific quality, and operational efficiency through new technologies and ways of working.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of analytical scientists, fostering technical excellence, engagement, and career growth.

- Provide strategic leadership for analytical development and phase-appropriate control strategies across small molecule development programs from early development through commercialization.

- Serve as the analytical lead within multidisciplinary CMC teams, influencing project strategy, risk management, and key development decisions.

- Provide strategic and technical leadership for regulatory submissions, including development and defense of analytical control strategies and responses to health authority questions.

- Lead analytical activities executed through CROs, CMOs, and external partners, ensuring high-quality delivery, scientific oversight, and effective resource utilization.

- Establish and execute analytical project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource strategies, and risk mitigation plans aligned with overall CMC objectives.

- Build strong partnerships across Drug Product Development and Supply, Drug Substance Development, Regulatory, Quality, Clinical Supply, and Commercial organizations to accelerate delivery of development milestones.

- Identify and implement innovative technologies, digital capabilities, and new ways of working that improve scientific outcomes, efficiency, and speed to patients.

- Contribute to the broader Analytical Research & Development organization through scientific leadership, talent development, operational excellence, and strategic initiatives.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or related discipline with 1+ years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience , OR
- MS in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or related discipline with 5+  years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience.

- 1 year of experience leading a small- to mid-sized team of Analytical Scientists
- Experience driving cross functional initiatives through matrix teams

- Experience leading analytical contributions to regulatory submissions , including development and defense of analytical strategies, specifications, and control strategies.
- Strong track record of working within and influencing cross-functional CMC development teams to deliver project milestones.

- Experience providing scientific and operational oversight of analytical activities conducted through CROs, CMOs, and external partners .

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience translating complex technical issues into clear scientific and business recommendations.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of formulation and process development, stability, specifications, product performance, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

- Experience supporting multiple molecular modalities, such as small molecules, peptides, or drug-linker intermediates.

- Record of advancing scientific initiatives, external collaborations, analytical technologies, or improved ways of working.

- Experience applying digital tools, modeling, simulation, automation, or integrated data approaches to analytical development.

- Experience influencing stakeholders and creating measurable scientific and business impact.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

- Occasional travel for internal and external partner meetings, conferences, or project support.

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.
Relocation support available

Work Location Assignment:  On Premise

Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage.
